info.title: PudimFinance API
info.description: Personal finance application API. Immutable double-entry ledger, event sourcing, real-time reporting, receipt scanning and price tracking.

post.summary: Anticipates (pays early) future installments on a credit card.
post.description:
Selected future installments are charged on the current bill (optionally
with a discount, as offered by many providers). Their expense transactions
are re-dated/re-priced into the current billing period, so they count in
this month's expenses and disappear from future months/bills.

get.summary: Lists all billing cycles for a credit card with computed totals.

post.summary: Pays a credit-card bill.
post.description:
Records the payment as a transfer, debiting the card and crediting the paying
account. It is never an expense, and it updates the bill's settlement state.

404.description: Credit card or bill not found

post.summary: Records a purchase on a credit card.
post.description:
Atomically creates the expense `transaction` (dated at purchase time, so it
counts in that month's expenses), posts balanced ledger entries (debit the
expense account, credit the card), and attaches it to the matching bill.

income, expenses, budgets, or reports.

account_kind.description:
User-facing kind such as `bank`, `cash`, `card`, `loan`, `investment`, or a
system kind (`income`/`expense`/`equity`/`other`).

balance.description:
Balance = SUM(debit_amount) − SUM(credit_amount) across ledger entries.
Positive for asset/expense accounts, negative for liability/income/equity
under standard double-entry semantics.

closing_day.description: Closing day of the monthly billing cycle (credit cards only, 1-31).

due_day.description: Payment due day of the monthly billing cycle (credit cards only, 1-31).

AnticipateInstallmentsRequest.description: Payload for anticipating (paying early) future installments on a card.

discount_amount.description: Fixed discount amount. Mutually exclusive with `discount_percent`.

discount_percent.description:
Discount as a percentage of the gross amount (0-100). Mutually exclusive

installment_ids.description: Installment rows to anticipate (must belong to plans linked to the card).

card_expense_dating.description:
How credit-card purchases are dated in the dashboard, budgets and
reports: `purchase_date` counts a purchase in the month it was made,
`due_date` counts it in the month the bill ("fatura") is due.
